# What JSON Web Tokens the library redacts, and what it leaves alone.
#
# A token is read for the marks RFC 7515 and RFC 7516 require of a header: a
# JSON object naming an algorithm in alg, and enc where the token is encrypted.
# The headers below are written out in the case names, since base64url hides
# them.

patterns: jwt

# Signed tokens.

case: a bearer token in an authorization header
in:   Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  Authorization: Bearer «jwt»

case: a token whose header names nothing but the algorithm
in:   eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  «jwt»

case: a token whose header names the algorithm last
in:   eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJraWQiOiJrZXktMSIsImFsZyI6IlJTMjU2In0.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  «jwt»

case: a header whose first member name opens with a digit
in:   eyIwIjoxLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  «jwt»

case: a header carrying an object of its own
in:   eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsIngiOnsieSI6InoifX0.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  «jwt»

case: a header closed with space after the brace
in:   eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9IA.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  «jwt»

case: a token with an empty signature
in:   eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.
out:  «jwt»

case: a header followed by two empty segments
in:   eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..
out:  «jwt»

case: a token whose payload carries a name with a space
in:   eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiIxMjM0NTY3ODkwIiwibmFtZSI6ImEgYiJ9.0123456789abcdef
out:  «jwt»

# Encrypted tokens, which RFC 7516 gives five parts.

case: an encrypted token
in:   eyJhbGciOiJkaXIiLCJlbmMiOiJBMTI4R0NNIn0.0123456789abcdef.0123456789.0123456789abcdef.0123456789abcdef
out:  «jwt»

case: a header naming a content encryption algorithm without the parts of an encrypted token
in:   eyJhbGciOiJkaXIiLCJlbmMiOiJBMTI4R0NNIn0.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  «jwt»

# Where a token sits.

case: a token in a json body
in:   {"access_token":"eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef","token_type":"Bearer"}
out:  {"access_token":"«jwt»","token_type":"Bearer"}

case: a token in a url query string
in:   https://example.com/callback?id_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef&state=abc
out:  https://example.com/callback?id_token=«jwt»&state=abc

case: a token in a cookie
in:   Cookie: session=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef; Path=/
out:  Cookie: session=«jwt»; Path=/

case: a token ending a sentence keeps the full stop
in:   the token is eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef.
out:  the token is «jwt».

case: two tokens on one line
in:   old=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef new=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJ4eXoifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  old=«jwt» new=«jwt»

case: a token after a candidate that is not a header
in:   eyJx.a.beyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  eyJx.a.b«jwt»

case: a token whose header sits inside a longer run of base64url characters
in:   xxxxeyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  xxxx«jwt»

# What is not a token.

case: a header prefix alone
in:   eyJ
out:  eyJ

case: a header with no segments after it
in:   eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9
out:  eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9

case: a header and a payload with no signature
in:   eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ
out:  eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ

case: a header naming no algorithm
in:   eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJraWQiOiIxIn0.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJraWQiOiIxIn0.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef

case: a header that never closes its object
in:   eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiI.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiI.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef

case: a header written with a space after the opening brace
in:   eyAiYWxnIjoiSFMyNTYifQ.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  eyAiYWxnIjoiSFMyNTYifQ.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef

case: a third character that cannot open a member name
in:   eyZhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  eyZhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef

# The third character in full. It carries the two highest bits of the byte
# after the quote, so the four it may be are the four the first character of a
# member name leaves: a digit, a letter, and the two a character outside ASCII
# leaves. Either side of those four is a candidate that does not open an object
# and a member name at all.

case: a header whose first member name opens with a character outside ascii
in:   eyLjgYIiOiJ4IiwiYWxnIjoiSFMyNTYifQ.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  «jwt»

case: a header whose first member name opens with a byte no character opens with
in:   eyKAIjoieCIsImFsZyI6IkhTMjU2In0.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  «jwt»

case: a candidate one character below the third character a header leaves
in:   eyHDqSJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  eyHDqSJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef

case: a candidate one character above it
in:   eyMiYWxnIjoiSFMyNTYifQ.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  eyMiYWxnIjoiSFMyNTYifQ.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef

case: base64url that decodes to no json at all
in:   aGVsbG8gd29ybGQ.aGVsbG8.aGVsbG8
out:  aGVsbG8gd29ybGQ.aGVsbG8.aGVsbG8

case: dots between header prefixes
in:   eyJ.eyJ.eyJ
out:  eyJ.eyJ.eyJ

case: prose holding the letters a header opens with
in:   they eyed the key and said nothing
out:  they eyed the key and said nothing

case: a token broken across two lines
in:   eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.\neyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.\neyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef

case: a header prefix repeated
in:   eyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJ
out:  eyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJ

# What a header may carry. RFC 7515 asks a JOSE header for alg and nothing
# else about the members beside it, so each of the registered parameters a real
# token carries is stated here rather than assumed to follow from the short
# headers above.

case: a header naming alg none with an empty signature, the unsecured token of rfc 7519
in:   eyJhbGciOiJub25lIn0.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.
out:  «jwt»

case: a header naming alg none with a signature after it
in:   eyJhbGciOiJub25lIiwidHlwIjoiSldUIn0.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  «jwt»

case: a header carrying a key id
in:   eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsImtpZCI6IjAxMjM0NTY3ODlhYmNkZWYifQ.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  «jwt»

case: a header carrying a jwk set url
in:   eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsImprdSI6Imh0dHBzOi8vZXhhbXBsZS5jb20va2V5cy5qc29uIn0.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  «jwt»

case: a header carrying a certificate chain
in:   eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsIng1YyI6WyJNSUlDMDEyMzQ1Njc4OWFiY2RlZiJdfQ.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  «jwt»

case: a header carrying crit
in:   eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsImNyaXQiOlsiZXhwIl0sImV4cCI6MX0.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  «jwt»

case: a header naming the content type as jwt, which rfc 7519 asks of a nested token
in:   eyJhbGciOiJkaXIiLCJlbmMiOiJBMTI4R0NNIiwiY3R5IjoiSldUIn0.0123456789abcdef.0123456789.0123456789abcdef.0123456789abcdef
out:  «jwt»

case: a header whose typ is the access token type of rfc 9068
in:   eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6ImF0K2p3dCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  «jwt»

case: a header carrying a member whose value is a number
in:   eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsIm4iOjF9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  «jwt»

case: a header carrying a member whose value is null
in:   eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsIngiOm51bGx9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  «jwt»

case: a header carrying a member whose value is a boolean
in:   eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsIngiOnRydWV9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  «jwt»

case: a header carrying an array before the algorithm
in:   eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJ4IjpbMSwyLDNdLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  «jwt»

case: a header naming the algorithm twice
in:   eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsImFsZyI6IlJTMjU2In0.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  «jwt»

case: a header naming an algorithm no registry holds
in:   eyJhbGciOiJYWDk5OSJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  «jwt»

case: a header whose algorithm is the empty string
in:   eyJhbGciOiIifQ.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  «jwt»

case: a header whose algorithm is a number
in:   eyJhbGciOjI1Nn0.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  «jwt»

case: a header whose algorithm is null
in:   eyJhbGciOm51bGx9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  «jwt»

case: a header carrying a non ascii value
in:   eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsIngiOiLjgYIifQ.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  «jwt»

# The JSON of a header, written the ways JSON allows. A header is base64url,
# so none of this is visible in the token: it is the difference between reading
# the bytes as JSON and matching them as text.

case: a header with a space either side of the colon
in:   eyJhbGciIDogIkhTMjU2In0.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  «jwt»

case: a header with a tab after the colon
in:   eyJhbGciOgkiSFMyNTYifQ.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  «jwt»

case: a header written over three lines
in:   ewoiYWxnIjoiSFMyNTYiCn0.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  ewoiYWxnIjoiSFMyNTYiCn0.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef

case: a header naming alg through a unicode escape
in:   eyJcdTAwNjFsZyI6IkhTMjU2In0.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  eyJcdTAwNjFsZyI6IkhTMjU2In0.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef

case: a header whose algorithm is written through unicode escapes
in:   eyJhbGciOiJIU1x1MDAzMlx1MDAzNVx1MDAzNiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  «jwt»

case: a header naming alg in capitals, which is another member entirely
in:   eyJBbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  eyJBbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef

case: a header that is an empty object
in:   e30.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  e30.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef

case: a header that is an array of objects
in:   W3siYWxnIjoiSFMyNTYifV0.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  W3siYWxnIjoiSFMyNTYifV0.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef

case: a header that is a json string
in:   ImFsZyI.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  ImFsZyI.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef

case: a header with a comma before the closing brace
in:   eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsfQ.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  «jwt»

case: a header written with single quotes
in:   eydhbGcnOidIUzI1Nid9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  eydhbGcnOidIUzI1Nid9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef

# The base64url of the segments themselves. RFC 7515 asks for base64url with
# no padding, which is what a token carries; text does not always oblige.

case: a header padded to a multiple of four
in:   eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsImsiOiIwIn0=.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsImsiOiIwIn0=.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef

case: a payload padded to a multiple of four
in:   eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmNkIn0=.0123456789abcdef
out:  eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmNkIn0=.0123456789abcdef

case: a header carrying the hyphen and underscore base64url is built from
in:   eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsIngiOiI_Pj8-In0.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  «jwt»

case: a header written in the standard base64 alphabet, with a slash and a plus
in:   eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsIngiOiI/Pj8+In0=.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsIngiOiI/Pj8+In0=.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef

case: a signature carrying hyphens and underscores
in:   eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef-_ABC
out:  «jwt»

case: a payload carrying hyphens and underscores
in:   eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.0123456789abcdef-_ABC.0123456789abcdef
out:  «jwt»

case: a signature of a single hyphen
in:   eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.-
out:  «jwt»

case: a signature of a single underscore
in:   eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ._
out:  «jwt»

# How many segments there are. RFC 7515 gives a signed token three and RFC
# 7516 gives an encrypted one five; what carries some other number is stated
# here rather than left to follow from either.

case: a signed token whose payload is empty, as a detached payload leaves it
in:   eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..0123456789abcdef
out:  «jwt»

case: an encrypted token whose key is empty, as the dir algorithm leaves it
in:   eyJhbGciOiJkaXIiLCJlbmMiOiJBMTI4R0NNIn0..0123456789.0123456789abcdef.0123456789abcdef
out:  «jwt»

case: an encrypted token whose every segment after the header is empty
in:   eyJhbGciOiJkaXIiLCJlbmMiOiJBMTI4R0NNIn0....
out:  «jwt»

case: a token of four segments
in:   eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef.0123456789
out:  «jwt».0123456789

case: a token of six segments
in:   eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef.0123456789.0123456789.0123456789
out:  «jwt».0123456789.0123456789.0123456789

case: a token whose header segment is empty
in:   .eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  .eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef

case: a header followed by a single dot and nothing else
in:   eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.
out:  eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.

case: a header followed by three dots
in:   eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...
out:  «jwt».

case: a header naming enc but no algorithm
in:   eyJlbmMiOiJBMTI4R0NNIn0.0123456789abcdef.0123456789.0123456789abcdef.0123456789abcdef
out:  eyJlbmMiOiJBMTI4R0NNIn0.0123456789abcdef.0123456789.0123456789abcdef.0123456789abcdef

case: a very long payload
in:   eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..0123456789abcdef
out:  «jwt»

case: a very long signature
in:   eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
out:  «jwt»

# Where a token sits.

case: a token in a proxy authorization header
in:   Proxy-Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  Proxy-Authorization: Bearer «jwt»

case: a token in a header of its own
in:   X-Auth-Token: eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  X-Auth-Token: «jwt»

case: a token in an authorization header written in lower case
in:   authorization: bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  authorization: bearer «jwt»

case: a token in an environment file
in:   JWT_TOKEN=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  JWT_TOKEN=«jwt»

case: a token in a fragment of yaml
in:   auth:\n  token: eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  auth:\n  token: «jwt»

case: a token in a fragment of toml
in:   [auth]\ntoken = "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef"
out:  [auth]\ntoken = "«jwt»"

case: a token in a markdown code span
in:   paste `eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef` into the box
out:  paste `«jwt»` into the box

case: a token in a markdown link
in:   [decode it](https://jwt.io/#debugger-io?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef)
out:  [decode it](https://jwt.io/#debugger-io?token=«jwt»)

case: a token in a url fragment
in:   https://example.com/#id_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  https://example.com/#id_token=«jwt»

case: a token preceded by a full stop
in:   see this.eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  see this.«jwt»

case: a token followed by a comma
in:   eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef, and the next one
out:  «jwt», and the next one

case: a token in parentheses
in:   (eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef)
out:  («jwt»)

case: a token in single quotes
in:   'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef'
out:  '«jwt»'

case: a token on a line a diff adds
in:   +JWT_TOKEN=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  +JWT_TOKEN=«jwt»

case: a token followed immediately by japanese
in:   eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdefです
out:  «jwt»です

case: a token preceded immediately by japanese
in:   トークンはeyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  トークンは«jwt»

case: a token between tabs
in:   jwt\teyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef\tvalid
out:  jwt\t«jwt»\tvalid

case: a token followed by a carriage return and a newline
in:   JWT_TOKEN=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef\r\nHOME=/root
out:  JWT_TOKEN=«jwt»\r\nHOME=/root

case: a token in a json array
in:   {"tokens":["eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef","eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJ4eXoifQ.0123456789abcdef"]}
out:  {"tokens":["«jwt»","«jwt»"]}

case: three tokens on one line
in:   a=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef b=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJ4eXoifQ.0123456789abcdef c=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJwcXIifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  a=«jwt» b=«jwt» c=«jwt»

case: the same token twice on one line
in:   eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef and eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef again
out:  «jwt» and «jwt» again

# Tokens with nothing between them. A signature is a run of base64url
# characters, so it swallows the header of the token behind it, which then
# begins inside the first value. The scan comes back for every start it read
# over, so both are located and the values overlap; one resuming past a value
# would leave the second whole.
#
# The case after states what that rule costs. A payload is base64url too, so
# one that decodes to a header of its own is a token to this pattern wherever
# the segments behind it reach, and nothing in the bytes tells it apart from
# the token above. The redaction then runs a segment further than the outer
# token does.

case: two tokens with nothing between them
in:   eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdefeyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  «jwt»

case: a token whose payload is a header in its own right
in:   eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.0123456789abcdef.a.b
out:  «jwt».b

case: a token in a curl command broken over two lines
in:   curl -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef" \\\n  https://api.example.com/v1/user
out:  curl -H "Authorization: Bearer «jwt»" \\\n  https://api.example.com/v1/user

# What is not a token.

case: a header carrying every mark but the algorithm
in:   eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJjdHkiOiJKV1QiLCJraWQiOiIwMTIzNDU2Nzg5YWJjZGVmIn0.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJjdHkiOiJKV1QiLCJraWQiOiIwMTIzNDU2Nzg5YWJjZGVmIn0.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef

case: a domain name
in:   api.github.com
out:  api.github.com

case: a version number
in:   v1.2.3
out:  v1.2.3

case: a file path with two dots in it
in:   0123456789abcdef.tar.gz
out:  0123456789abcdef.tar.gz

case: a three part identifier that is not base64url
in:   one.two.three!
out:  one.two.three!

case: a header prefix in lower case
in:   eyj.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  eyj.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef

case: a header prefix followed by a character base64url does not hold
in:   eyJ!.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  eyJ!.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef

case: base64url that decodes to a json array of numbers
in:   WzEsMiwzXQ.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  WzEsMiwzXQ.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef

# The header below decodes to a brace, a quote and one byte more, which is
# shorter than the smallest object naming a member. That those bytes are not
# valid UTF-8 is not what settles it: a header is read for the marks RFC 7515
# asks of one and for nothing else, so the header further up this file whose
# first member name opens with a byte no character opens with — bytes no more
# valid than these — is a token.

case: a header too short to name an algorithm
in:   eyL_.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  eyL_.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef

case: a header with a space instead of a dot after it
in:   eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9 eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ 0123456789abcdef
out:  eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9 eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ 0123456789abcdef

case: a token whose dots are commas
in:   eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9,eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ,0123456789abcdef
out:  eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9,eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ,0123456789abcdef

case: a token whose dots are colons
in:   eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9:eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ:0123456789abcdef
out:  eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9:eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ:0123456789abcdef

case: prose holding the word key twice
in:   the key to the key is not a key at all
out:  the key to the key is not a key at all
